The season began on 31 July 2026.{{cite news |url=https://www.prvaliga.rs/en/sezona/raspored-i-rezultati/ |title=Serbia First League Schedule & Results |access-date=29 September 2026}} This season was widely presented in the media as the strongest since the competition was established, largely due to the high number of former SuperLiga clubs and the quality of the infrastructure, with several stadiums meeting UEFA standards, including [[TSC Arena]], [[Lagator Stadium|Lagator]], [[Dubočica Stadium|Dubočica]], [[Voždovac Stadium]] and [[Kraljevica Stadium|Kraljevica]].{{cite news |url=https://www.prvaliga.rs/pocinje-nikad-jaca-mozzart-bet-prva-liga-rekordnih-sedam-meceva-pod-reflektorima/ |title=Počinje nikad jača Mozzart Bet Prva liga, rekordnih sedam mečeva pod reflektorima}} ==League format== Each team will play every other team twice in a round-robin format. After the preliminary phase, the top six teams will advance to the Championship round, while the remaining ten teams will enter the Relegation round. The first two teams in the Championship round will be promoted to the [[Serbian SuperLiga]], while the teams finishing 11th to 16th overall will be relegated to the [[Serbian League]].{{cite web
